name: ShipBob 3PL Warehousing
description: Omnichannel fulfillment for Shopify, Walmart, and TikTok Shop with 50+ warehouses across US, UK, and EU.
fullDescription: ShipBob is a premier tech-enabled 3PL that powers fulfillment for fast-growing direct-to-consumer and multi-channel brands. With a distributed network of dozens of fulfillment centers across the United States, Canada, Europe, and Australia, brands can split inventory to achieve 2-day ground shipping nationwide.
features: Distributed inventory network across 50+ fulfillment centers globally
Native 2-day ground delivery program for Shopify, TikTok Shop, and Walmart
Proprietary warehouse management software (WMS) with real-time stock levels
Custom unboxing experiences including branded boxes, stickers, and inserts
Automated order routing to the closest geographic fulfillment center
